state.seed_assertion: Before using a multimeter on a circuit, a technician should identify what is being measured, what reading is expected, what the reading proves, and what will be checked next.

sentences.1: Software faults tend to be repeatable and occur when a specific set of conditions is present, whereas hardware faults are affected by environmental conditions.
sentences.2: A software fault may seem intermittent, but normally this is because a very specific set of conditions needs to be present to cause the fault.
sentences.3: A standard multimeter samples far too slowly to catch a micro-second voltage spike.
sentences.4: Even some high-end oscilloscopes might miss a disruptive event if the trigger isn't set perfectly.
sentences.5: You can also set up "trap logic." These are simple rungs of code designed to latch a bit the moment a millisecond signal drop occurs.
sentences.6: An input voltage reading between 18 and 30 volts with the PLC bit ON indicates the input card and wiring are functioning correctly.
sentences.7: Set the reminder early enough for someone to act on it, not just notice it.
sentences.8: Using the PLC's online monitor alongside multimeter measurements reveals faults faster than either tool alone.
